'''Chief Design Engineer''' was a position within the [[Starship/Legends|shipbuilding]] corporation [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]],<ref name="ATATSpecPlate" /> as well as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy Research, Development and Engineering Center]] and [[Imperial Department of Military Research/Legends|Imperial Department of Military Research]] divisions. [[R. McQuarrie]] was an individual who held this position in both organizations.<ref name="ISDSpecPlate" />

==Behind the scenes==
The position of Chief Design Engineer was first mentioned on [["Imperial Star Destroyer" SpecPlate]], a [[2010]] fine-art print designed by [[Louis Solis]].<ref name="ISDSpecPlate" />
